title: Weatherways
intro: Midrath's skies turn on a fixed wheel, the same for every Envoy. Most hours run from fair to foul and back again, and a few of those turns leave something behind.

clear.0.name: Clear Skies
clear.0.blurb: Still air and not a cloud over Midrath. Good light for travel and for spotting what hides in the grass.

light.0.name: Fresh Breeze
light.0.blurb: Clear skies with a steady wind through the trees. The fair spell is ending.

light.1.name: Thin Cloud
light.1.blurb: A faint haze and a light breeze. The sky is turning, slowly.

moderate.0.name: Gale
moderate.0.blurb: Hard, dry wind under a nearly clear sky. No rain comes of it.

moderate.1.name: Gathering Grey
moderate.1.blurb: Half the sky is cloud and the wind is up. Rain is close but not falling.

moderate.2.name: Passing Showers
moderate.2.blurb: Steady rain under broken cloud. When it clears, a rainbow may follow.

heavy.0.name: Downpour
heavy.0.blurb: A full grey sky, driving rain and wind. Take shelter, or press on soaked.

heavy.1.name: Thunderstorm
heavy.1.blurb: Downpour with lightning crossing the sky. A Voltaic caster's hour.

post_rain.name: After the Rain
post_rain.note: Applies once a rain type ends; the buff's duration is not traced yet.

rainbow.name: Rainbow
rainbow.note: Only after Passing Showers (20%). The roll depends on the sky's recent-rain state and is not predicted.

fog.name: Fog
fog.note: No weather preset carries fog directly; probably tied to overcast. Not shown in forecasts until traced.
